When the , this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.

3. Install dependencies. Before using the model for inference, you need to install the corresponding dependencies. After the image is installed, execute the `docker images` command to view the corresponding ID. Just replace it in the above command. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `

5. Use models for inference. Take the LLaMA3 series model as an example. For details, please refer to the instructions in "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH/examples/models/llama3/README.md" in the container. For other models, please refer to [模型列表](https://www.hiascend.com/software/mindie/modellist). Execute the following command for inference: `cd $ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights # 请修改权重路径 ` Print the default question "Question" and the inference result "Answer", as shown below: `2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Question[0]: What's deep learning? 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Answer[0]: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks to learn from data. 6. MindIE Motor is an inference service-oriented framework for general model scenarios. It provides inference service-oriented capabilities through an open and scalable inference service-oriented platform architecture, supports docking with the industry's mainstream inference framework interfaces,meets the high-performance inference requirements of large language models. - The NPU driver and firmware have been installed on the host machine. If it is not installed, download [固件与驱动](https://hiascend.com/hardware/firmware-drivers/community) and select the corresponding community version or commercial version of firmware and driver according to the product series and model. Please refer to the following command to install:
```bash
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --full --force
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run --full
```
- Users install Docker on the host machine by themselves (the version requirement is greater than or equal to 24.x.x). For the installation of Docker, see [安装Docker](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/docker_installation/).
- Before configuring the source, please ensure that the installation environment can connect to the network.

Description

For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, the operating system compatibility requirements of the host and container image are as follows:

- Ubuntu 22.04 host supports running Ubuntu 24.04 container image
- openEuler 22.03 host supports running openEuler 24.03 container image

Please select a compatible container image version based on the host operating system.

#### Get MindIE image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96mindie%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)

2. Click the login button in the upper right corner of the page and log in with your Huawei account (if you have not registered yet, please register first).
3. On the "Image Version" tab of the MindIE image download page, click the "Download Now" button in the "**Operation**" column behind the corresponding image according to your device form.
4. Download the image according to the image download operation guide page that pops up, as shown in [图1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#figure1). **Figure 1** Mirror download

1. Execute the following corresponding commands according to the device form to start the container. The container startup command is for reference only and can be modified according to your needs. The command parameters are introduced as shown in [表1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#table1). **Atlas 800I A3 Inference Server** `bash docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=500g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ -w /home \ --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci2:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci3:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \ --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \ --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \ -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \ -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \ -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \ -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \ {IMAGE_ID} bash` Description `{IMAGE_ID}` is the image ID. After the image is installed, execute the `docker images` command to view the corresponding ID. Just replace it in the above command. For the `--device` parameter, the mounting permission is set to `rwm` instead of `rw` or `r` with smaller permissions. information and run the MindIE business normally but if the mounted If the npu (corresponding to `davinci_xxx_` in the mount option, for example, `npu0` corresponds to `davinci0`) is occupied by other tasks, using the `npu-smi` command will print an error and the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). >- For the Atlas 800I A3 super node server, if the mount permission is set to `rw`, after entering the container, an error will be printed when using the `npu-smi` command,the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). **Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module** When starting the container, you need to additionally mount some driver libraries and configuration files that npu-smi depends on. If it is not mounted, executing npu-smi related commands in the container may fail. The startup commands for different container image operating systems are as follows: Ubuntu 24.04 image: `docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=1g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，若业务最大并发数较高， this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `
3. Install dependencies. Before using the model for inference, you need to install the corresponding dependencies. The path of the dependency installation file (requirements_*xxx*.txt) of each model is /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models. Taking the LLaMA3 series model as an example, use the following command to install the dependencies. `cd /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models pip3 install -r requirements_llama3.txt `
4. Execute the following command to enable MindIE log printing. `export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT="true" `
5. Use models for inference. Take the LLaMA3 series model as an example. For details, please refer to the instructions in "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH/examples/models/llama3/README.md" in the container. For other models, please refer to [模型列表](https://www.hiascend.com/software/mindie/modellist). Execute the following command for inference: `cd $ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights # 请修改权重路径 ` Print the default question "Question" and the inference result "Answer", as shown below: `2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Question[0]: What's deep learning? 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Answer[0]: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks to learn from data. Neural networks are 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Generate[0] token num: (0, 20) ` If the user wants to customize the input question, he can use the "--input_texts" parameter setting, such as: `python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights --input_texts "What is deep learning?" # 请修改权重路径 ` Note "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH" has been set in ".bashrc", there is no need to set it yourself.
6. MindIE Motor is an inference service-oriented framework for general model scenarios. ### Weight

### Path variable explanation

| Variable name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| working_dir | The directory where the acceleration library and model library are placed after downloading (only used in source code download scenarios) |

#### Atlas 800I A2 w8a8 Quantization

W8A8 quantized weights can be achieved through [msmodelslim Qwen](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/tree/master/example/Qwen) (Ascend model compression tool).

- Note that this quantization method only supports running on Atlas 800I A2 server
- Please refer to [msmodelslim](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/docs/zh/getting_started/install_guide.md) to install msModelSlim quantification tool
- Enter the directory `cd msmodelslim/example/Qwen` of msmodelslim/example/Qwenrun the quantization conversion script in the Qwen directory you entered.
```bash
python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/teacher_qualification.jsonl --w_bit 8 --a_bit 8 --device_type npu --anti_method m4
```
- Please replace {floating point weight path} and {quantized weight path} with the user's actual path.
- If you need to use npu multi-card quantization, please configure the environment variables first to support multi-card quantization. It is recommended to use dual cards to perform quantization:
```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:False
```

- Step 1
  - Modify the `torch_dtype` field in the model weight config.json to `float16`
  - Please refer to [msmodelslim](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/docs/zh/getting_started/install_guide.md) to install msModelSlim quantification tool
  - Enter the directory `cd msmodelslim/example/Qwen` of msmodelslim/example/Qwenrun the quantization conversion script in the entered Qwen directory

> Note: After installing CANN, you need to execute source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh to declare the ASCEND_HOME_PATH value. You must ensure that it is not empty before installing msmodelslim.
> When installing CANN, if the user does not specify an installation path, the software will be installed to the default path. The default installation path is as follows: root user: "/usr/local/Ascend", non-root user: "${HOME}/Ascend", ${HOME} is the current user directory.

```shell
      export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
      export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:False
      python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8S 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/cn_en.jsonl --w_bit 4 --a_bit 8 --fraction 0.011 --co_sparse True --device_type npu --use_sigma True --is_lowbit True --sigma_factor 4.0 --anti_method m4

```
```bash
      python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8S 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/cn_en.jsonl --w_bit 4 --a_bit 8 --fraction 0.011 --co_sparse True --device_type cpu --use_sigma True --is_lowbit True --sigma_factor 4.0 --anti_method m4

```

Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. 2. Click the login button in the upper right corner of the page and log in with your Huawei account (if you have not registered yet, please register first).
3. On the "Image Version" tab of the MindIE image download page, click the "Download Now" button in the "**Operation**" column behind the corresponding image according to your device form.
4. Download the image according to the image download operation guide page that pops up, as shown in [图1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#figure1). **Figure 1** Mirror download

#### Use image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)
1. Execute the following corresponding commands according to the device form to start the container. The container startup command is for reference only and can be modified according to your needs. The command parameters are introduced as shown in [表1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#table1). **Atlas 800I A3 Inference Server** `bash docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=500g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ -w /home \ --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci2:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci3:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \ --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \ --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \ -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \ -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \ -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \ -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \ {IMAGE_ID} bash` Description `{IMAGE_ID}` is the image ID. After the image is installed, execute the `docker images` command to view the corresponding ID. Just replace it in the above command. For the `--device` parameter, the mounting permission is set to `rwm` instead of `rw` or `r` with smaller permissions. information and run the MindIE business normally but if the mounted If the npu (corresponding to `davinci_xxx_` in the mount option, for example, `npu0` corresponds to `davinci0`) is occupied by other tasks, using the `npu-smi` command will print an error and the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). >- For the Atlas 800I A3 super node server, if the mount permission is set to `rw`, after entering the container, an error will be printed when using the `npu-smi` command,the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). **Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module** When starting the container, you need to additionally mount some driver libraries and configuration files that npu-smi depends on. If it is not mounted, executing npu-smi related commands in the container may fail. The startup commands for different container image operating systems are as follows: Ubuntu 24.04 image: `docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=1g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，若业务最大并发数较高， this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `
3. Install dependencies. Before using the model for inference, you need to install the corresponding dependencies. The path of the dependency installation file (requirements_*xxx*.txt) of each model is /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models. Taking the LLaMA3 series model as an example, use the following command to install the dependencies. `cd /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models pip3 install -r requirements_llama3.txt `
4. Execute the following command to enable MindIE log printing. `export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT="true" `

For other models, please refer to [模型列表](https://www.hiascend.com/software/mindie/modellist). Neural networks are 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Generate[0] token num: (0, 20) ` If the user wants to customize the input question, he can use the "--input_texts" parameter setting, such as: `python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights --input_texts "What is deep learning?" # 请修改权重路径 ` Note "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH" has been set in ".bashrc", there is no need to set it yourself.

#### run package installation method [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/installation_on_a_physical_machine/#run%E5%8C%85%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E6%96%B9%E5%BC%8F)

This article introduces the steps to install MindIE through the run package method. This method will install the components of MindIE Motor, MindIE LLM and MindIE SD in sequence. The path of the component package is under the sub-path of MindIE.

1. Log in to the installation environment as the installation user of the CANN software package.
2. Upload the obtained MindIE software package to any path in the installation environment (such as /home/package).
3. Enter the path where the software package is located. `cd /home/package `
4. Add executable permissions to the software package. `chmod +x 软件包名.run ` **Software package name.run** indicates the development kit package Ascend-mindie_\_linux-\_\.run. Please replace it according to the actual package name.
5. Run the following command to add the environment variables of the ascend-toolkit package. (Take the root user as an example. The following is the default installation path for the root user.) `source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh `

W8A8 quantized weights can be achieved through [msmodelslim Qwen](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/tree/master/example/Qwen) (Ascend model compression tool).

- Please refer to [msmodelslim](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/docs/zh/getting_started/install_guide.md) to install msModelSlim quantification tool
- Enter the directory `cd msmodelslim/example/Qwen` of msmodelslim/example/Qwenrun the quantization conversion script in the Qwen directory you entered.
```bash
python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/teacher_qualification.jsonl --w_bit 8 --a_bit 8 --device_type npu --anti_method m4
```
- Please replace {floating point weight path} and {quantized weight path} with the user's actual path.
- If you need to use npu multi-card quantization, please configure the environment variables first to support multi-card quantization. It is recommended to use dual cards to perform quantization:
```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:False
```
#### Atlas 300I DUO/Atlas 300I Pro/Atlas 300V Sparse quantization

- Step 1
  - Note that this quantization method only supports running on Atlas 300I DUO/Atlas 300I Pro/Atlas 300V cards
  - Modify the `torch_dtype` field in the model weight config.json to `float16`
  - Please refer to [msmodelslim](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/docs/zh/getting_started/install_guide.md) to install msModelSlim quantification tool

> Note: After installing CANN, you need to execute source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh to declare the ASCEND_HOME_PATH value. You must ensure that it is not empty before installing msmodelslim.

**Atlas 300I DUO** uses the following method to generate W8A8S quantified weights
```shell
      export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
      export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:False
      python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8S 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/cn_en.jsonl --w_bit 4 --a_bit 8 --fraction 0.011 --co_sparse True --device_type npu --use_sigma True --is_lowbit True --sigma_factor 4.0 --anti_method m4

```
**Atlas 300I Pro/Atlas 300V** uses the following method to generate W8A8S quantized weights
```bash
      python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8S 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/cn_en.jsonl --w_bit 4 --a_bit 8 --fraction 0.011 --co_sparse True --device_type cpu --use_sigma True --is_lowbit True --sigma_factor 4.0 --anti_method m4

```

When the , this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.

Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `
3. Install dependencies. Before using the model for inference, you need to install the corresponding dependencies. Taking the LLaMA3 series model as an example, use the following command to install the dependencies. `cd /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models pip3 install -r requirements_llama3.txt `

If it is not mounted, executing npu-smi related commands in the container may fail. The startup commands for different container image operating systems are as follows: Ubuntu 24.04 image: `docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=1g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，若业务最大并发数较高， this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `
3. Install dependencies. Before using the model for inference, you need to install the corresponding dependencies. The path of the dependency installation file (requirements_*xxx*.txt) of each model is /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models. Taking the LLaMA3 series model as an example, use the following command to install the dependencies. `cd /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models pip3 install -r requirements_llama3.txt `

For other models, please refer to [模型列表](https://www.hiascend.com/software/mindie/modellist). Execute the following command for inference: `cd $ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights # 请修改权重路径 ` Print the default question "Question" and the inference result "Answer", as shown below: `2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Question[0]: What's deep learning? 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Answer[0]: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks to learn from data. Neural networks are 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Generate[0] token num: (0, 20) ` If the user wants to customize the input question, he can use the "--input_texts" parameter setting, such as: `python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights --input_texts "What is deep learning?" # 请修改权重路径 ` Note "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH" has been set in ".bashrc", there is no need to set it yourself.
6. MindIE Motor is an inference service-oriented framework for general model scenarios. It provides inference service-oriented capabilities through an open and scalable inference service-oriented platform architecture, supports docking with the industry's mainstream inference framework interfaces,meets the high-performance inference requirements of large language models. For the method of connecting to Motor, please refer to [快速入门](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/quick_start/quick_start/#%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86).

If it is not installed, download [固件与驱动](https://hiascend.com/hardware/firmware-drivers/community) and select the corresponding community version or commercial version of firmware and driver according to the product series and model. Please refer to the following command to install:
```bash
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run

- Users install Docker on the host machine by themselves (the version requirement is greater than or equal to 24.x.x). For the installation of Docker, see [安装Docker](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/docker_installation/).
- Before configuring the source, please ensure that the installation environment can connect to the network.

Description

For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, the operating system compatibility requirements of the host and container image are as follows:

- Ubuntu 22.04 host supports running Ubuntu 24.04 container image
- openEuler 22.03 host supports running openEuler 24.03 container image

Please select a compatible container image version based on the host operating system.

#### Get MindIE image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96mindie%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)

对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ --device=/dev/davinci0:/dev/davinci0 \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager \ --device=/dev/ascend_manager \ --device=/dev/user_config \ -v /etc/sys_version.conf:/etc/sys_version.conf \ -v /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf:/etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf \ -v /etc/hdcBasic.cfg:/etc/hdcBasic.cfg \ -v /var/dmp_daemon:/var/dmp_daemon \ -v /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2:/usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2 \ -v /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so:/usr/lib64/libmmpa.so \ -v /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1:/usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1 \ -v /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9:/usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2 \ -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \ -v /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so:/usr/lib64/libstackcore.so \ -v /etc/slog.conf:/etc/slog.conf \ -v /var/slogd:/var/slogd \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64 \ -v /path-to-weights:/path-to-weights:ro \ mindie:3.0.0-300I-DUO-py311-openEuler24.03-lts bash ` **Table 1** Parameter description Parameter Description --pids-limit -1 means to lift the limit on the number of processes. When the , this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `

## Prerequisites

### Characteristic Matrix

- The following table shows the features supported by each version of the Qwen model

| Model and parameter quantity | 300I DUO Tensor Parallelism | FP16 | BF16 | Flash Attention | Paged Attention | W8A8 quantization | W8A16 quantization | KV cache quantization | Sparse quantization (only supports 300I DUO) | MOE quantization | MindIE Service | TGI | Long sequence | prefix_cache | FA3 Quantization | functioncall | Multi LoRA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B | Support world size 2,4,8 | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ | ❌ |

Note: The supported world size shown in the table is a configuration that can be run through the dialogue test. In actual operation, the video memory usage caused by the length of the input sequence must also be considered.

 300I DUO only supports float16 floating point type. You need to modify the `config.json` file in the weight directory, **"torch_dtype" field is changed to "float16"**
- Sparse quantization w8a8sc is only supported on 300I DUO
generate w8a8s weights. Only single card or cpu generation of w8a8s weights is supported on 300I DUO. Step 2: w8a8sc needs to be split on 300I DUO.

### Weight

**Weight download**

-[DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B](https://modelers.cn/models/State_Cloud/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B)

### Path variable explanation

| Variable name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| working_dir | The directory where the acceleration library and model library are placed after downloading (only used in source code download scenarios) |
| llm_path | The path where the model warehouse is located. If you use a mirror, the path is `/usr/local/Ascend/atb-models`; if you use the code downloaded by gitcode, the path is `${working_dir}/MindIE-LLM/examples/atb_models` |
| script_path | The path where the script is located. The working script of the QWen series model is located in the path `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen` |
| weight_path | Model weight path |

W8A8 quantized weights can be achieved through [msmodelslim Qwen](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/tree/master/example/Qwen) (Ascend model compression tool).

- Please refer to [msmodelslim](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/docs/zh/getting_started/install_guide.md) to install msModelSlim quantification tool
- Enter the directory `cd msmodelslim/example/Qwen` of msmodelslim/example/Qwenrun the quantization conversion script in the Qwen directory you entered.
```bash
python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/boolq.jsonl --w_bit 8 --a_bit 8 --device_type npu
```
- Please replace {floating point weight path} and {quantized weight path} with the user's actual path.
- If you need to use npu multi-card quantization, please configure the environment variables first to support multi-card quantization. It is recommended to use dual cards to perform quantization:
```bash
export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:False
```
#### Atlas 300I DUO/Atlas 300I Pro/Atlas 300V Sparse quantization

- Step 1
  - Note that this quantization method only supports running on Atlas 300I DUO/Atlas 300I Pro/Atlas 300V cards
  - Modify the `torch_dtype` field in the model weight config.json to `float16`
  - Please refer to [msmodelslim](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/docs/zh/getting_started/install_guide.md) to install msModelSlim quantification tool
  - Enter the directory `cd msmodelslim/example/Qwen` of msmodelslim/example/Qwenrun the quantization conversion script in the entered Qwen directory

> Note: After installing CANN, you need to execute source ${HOME}/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh to declare the ASCEND_HOME_PATH value. You must ensure that it is not empty before installing msmodelslim.
> When installing CANN, if the user does not specify an installation path, the software will be installed to the default path. The default installation path is as follows: root user: "/usr/local/Ascend", non-root user: "${HOME}/Ascend", ${HOME} is the current user directory.

```shell
      export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3
      export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:False
      python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8S 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/cn_en.jsonl --w_bit 4 --a_bit 8 --fraction 0.011 --co_sparse True --device_type npu --use_sigma True --is_lowbit True --sigma_factor 4.0 --anti_method m4

```
**Atlas 300I DUO/Atlas 300I Pro/Atlas 300V** uses the following method to generate W8A8S quantized weights. The machine memory needs to be at least 350G, otherwise it may exit early due to insufficient memory.
```bash
      python3 quant_qwen.py --model_path {浮点权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8S 量化权重路径} --calib_file ../common/cn_en.jsonl --w_bit 4 --a_bit 8 --fraction 0.011 --co_sparse True --device_type cpu --use_sigma True --is_lowbit True --sigma_factor 4.0 --anti_method m4

```
> The quantification process of Atlas 300I DUO/Atlas 300I Pro/Atlas 300V takes a long time,then move it to Atlas 300I DUO/Atlas 300I Pro/Atlas 300V to perform subsequent steps.

- Step 2: Quantitative weight segmentation and compression
```shell
    # 执行"jq --version"查看是否安装 jq，若返回"bash：jq：command not found"，则依次执行"apt-get update"和"apt install jq"
    jq --version
    export IGNORE_INFER_ERROR=1
    cd ${llm_path}
    torchrun --nproc_per_node {TP 数} -m examples.convert.model_slim.sparse_compressor --multiprocess_num 4 --model_path {W8A8S 量化权重路径} --save_directory {W8A8SC 量化权重路径}

```
- The number of TP is the number of tensor parallel parallels
  - Note: If the weight is generated with TP=4 for segmentation, it also needs to be run with TP=4.

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

部署 DeepSeek-V3 模型用 W8A8 量化权重进行推理则至少需要 2 台 Atlas 800I A2 (8\*64G)。

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh

chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. docker images

| CANN | 8.0.T63 |

#### Start container

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

部署 DeepSeek-V3 模型用 W8A8 量化权重进行推理则至少需要 2 台 Atlas 800I A2 (8\*64G)。

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ5QZX> |

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

DeepSeek-V3 image version: 2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts
The name of the image after loading: swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \
      --device=/dev/davinci7 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      --device /dev/devmm_svm \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
      bash

```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
   docker exec -it {容器名称} bash

```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
   source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh

#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash

   双机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=16
   四机：

   export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0

```

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ5QZX> |

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \
      --device=/dev/davinci7 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      --device /dev/devmm_svm \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
      bash

```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
   docker exec -it {容器名称} bash

```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
   source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh

```
#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash
   export ATB_LLM_HCCL_ENABLE=1
   export ATB_LLM_COMM_BACKEND="hccl"
   export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=7200 # 该环境变量需要配置为整数，取值范围[120,7200]，单位 s
   双机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=16
   四机：

   export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0

```

Enter the same container and send a request to the server.

For more information, please refer to the official website information: [MindIE Service](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindie/100/mindieservice/servicedev/mindie_service0285.html).

``` json

         "tp": 8,

      {

         "tp": 8,
         "moe_tp": 1,
         "moe_ep": 16,

               "ep_level": 2
            }
         }
      },
   ]
}
```
