The MTP feature improves performance more obviously for lower concurrency. The current version recommends MTP=1 or 2.
``` json
{

      {

      }
   ]
}
```
#### NZ format KV Cache
``` json
{

         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "kv_cache_options": {
                  "enable_nz": true
               }
            }
         }
      }
   ]
}
```
#### Weight prefetching
``` json
{

      {
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "enable_oproj_prefetch": true,
               "enable_mlapo_prefetch": true
            }
         }
      }
   ]
}
```

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

Deploying the DeepSeek-R1 model for inference using W8A8 quantized weights requires at least 2 Atlas 800I A2 (8\*64G).

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-R1 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1) |
| DeepSeek-R1-Zero | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Zero/tree/main) | None |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-R1, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user has downloaded the FP8 weights from the link above, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-R1} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-R1-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-R1` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-R1,`/path/to/DeepSeek-R1-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-R1 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ4QZX> |

#### W8A8 quantized weight generation (BF16 to INT8)

Currently supported: Generate model W8A8 mixed quantization weights, using histogram quantization method (MLA: W8A8 quantization, MOE: W8A8 dynamic pertoken quantization).

Please refer to [DeepSeek 量化说明](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/example/DeepSeek/README.md) for details

Note: The DeepSeek-R1 model has a large weight,it takes a long time to generate the quantized weights. Please wait patiently the specific time is proportional to the size of the calibration data set,10 pieces of data will take about 3 hours.

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the model folder's group to 1001 -HwHiAiUser's group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored).
- Execute permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-R1}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-R1}
```Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-R1 currently uses the DeepSeek-V2 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

Image version of DeepSeek-R1: 2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts
The name of the image after loading: swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
   --shm-size 500g \
   --device=/dev/davinci0 \
   --device=/dev/davinci1 \
   --device=/dev/davinci2 \
   --device=/dev/davinci3 \
   --device=/dev/davinci4 \
   --device=/dev/davinci5 \
   --device=/dev/davinci6 \
   --device=/dev/davinci7 \
   --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
   --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
   --device /dev/devmm_svm \
   -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
   -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
   -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
   -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
   -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
   -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
   -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
    {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
   bash
```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
docker exec -it {容器名称} bash
```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh
```
#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash
export ATB_LLM_HCCL_ENABLE=1
export ATB_LLM_COMM_BACKEND="hccl"
export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=7200 # 该环境变量需要配置为整数，取值范围[120,7200]，单位 s
双机：
export WORLD_SIZE=16
四机：
export WORLD_SIZE=32
export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0
```

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-R1 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1) |
| DeepSeek-R1-Zero | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Zero/tree/main) | None |

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-R1, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user has downloaded the FP8 weights from the link above, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-R1} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-R1-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-R1` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-R1,`/path/to/DeepSeek-R1-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-R1 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ4QZX> |

#### W8A8 quantized weight generation (BF16 to INT8)

Currently supported: Generate model W8A8 mixed quantization weights, using histogram quantization method (MLA: W8A8 quantization, MOE: W8A8 dynamic pertoken quantization).

Please refer to [DeepSeek 量化说明](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/example/DeepSeek/README.md) for details

Note: The DeepSeek-R1 model has a large weight,it takes a long time to generate the quantized weights. Please wait patiently the specific time is proportional to the size of the calibration data set,10 pieces of data will take about 3 hours.

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the model folder's group to 1001 -HwHiAiUser's group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored).
- Execute permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-R1}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-R1}
```Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-R1 currently uses the DeepSeek-V2 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
   --shm-size 500g \
   --device=/dev/davinci0 \
   --device=/dev/davinci1 \
   --device=/dev/davinci2 \
   --device=/dev/davinci3 \
   --device=/dev/davinci4 \
   --device=/dev/davinci5 \
   --device=/dev/davinci6 \
   --device=/dev/davinci7 \
   --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
   --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
   --device /dev/devmm_svm \
   -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
   -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
   -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
   -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
   -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
   -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
   -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
    {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
   bash
```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
docker exec -it {容器名称} bash
```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh
```
#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash

export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0
```

[Usage Scenario] Benchmark real customer online scenarios, use different concurrency, different sending frequencies, different input lengths and output length distributions to test service performance

Variable meaning: expandable_segments - enables the memory pool expansion segment function, that is, the virtual memory feature. For more details please see [昇腾环境变量参考](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/600/apiref/Envvariables/Envir_009.html)

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-R1 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1) |
| DeepSeek-R1-Zero | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Zero/tree/main) | None |

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-R1, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user has downloaded the FP8 weights from the link above, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-R1} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-R1-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-R1` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-R1,`/path/to/DeepSeek-R1-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-R1 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ4QZX> |

#### W8A8 quantized weight generation (BF16 to INT8)

Currently supported: Generate model W8A8 mixed quantization weights, using histogram quantization method (MLA: W8A8 quantization, MOE: W8A8 dynamic pertoken quantization).

Please refer to [DeepSeek 量化说明](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/example/DeepSeek/README.md) for details

Note: The DeepSeek-R1 model has a large weight,it takes a long time to generate the quantized weights. Please wait patiently the specific time is proportional to the size of the calibration data set,10 pieces of data will take about 3 hours.

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the model folder's group to 1001 -HwHiAiUser's group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored).
- Execute permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-R1}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-R1}
```Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-R1 currently uses the DeepSeek-V2 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
   --shm-size 500g \
   --device=/dev/davinci0 \
   --device=/dev/davinci1 \
   --device=/dev/davinci2 \
   --device=/dev/davinci3 \
   --device=/dev/davinci4 \
   --device=/dev/davinci5 \
   --device=/dev/davinci6 \
   --device=/dev/davinci7 \
   --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
   --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
   --device /dev/devmm_svm \
   -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
   -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
   -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
   -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
   -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
   -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
   -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
    {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
   bash
```
#### Enter the container

```sh
docker exec -it {容器名称} bash

python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-R1} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-R1-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-R1` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-R1,`/path/to/DeepSeek-R1-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-R1 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ4QZX> |

#### W8A8 quantized weight generation (BF16 to INT8)

Currently supported: Generate model W8A8 mixed quantization weights, using histogram quantization method (MLA: W8A8 quantization, MOE: W8A8 dynamic pertoken quantization).

Please refer to [DeepSeek 量化说明](https://gitcode.com/Ascend/msmodelslim/blob/master/example/DeepSeek/README.md) for details

Note: The DeepSeek-R1 model has a large weight,it takes a long time to generate the quantized weights. Please wait patiently the specific time is proportional to the size of the calibration data set,10 pieces of data will take about 3 hours.

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference

```sh

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

部署 DeepSeek-V3 模型用 W8A8 量化权重进行推理则至少需要 2 台 Atlas 800I A2 (8\*64G)。

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ5QZX> |

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

DeepSeek-V3 image version: 2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts
The name of the image after loading: swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \
      --device=/dev/davinci7 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      --device /dev/devmm_svm \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
      bash

```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
   docker exec -it {容器名称} bash

```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
   source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh

```
#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash
   export ATB_LLM_HCCL_ENABLE=1
   export ATB_LLM_COMM_BACKEND="hccl"
   export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=7200 # 该环境变量需要配置为整数，取值范围[120,7200]，单位 s
   双机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=16
   四机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=32
   export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0

```

## Deployment

### Service-based reasoning

[Usage Scenario] Benchmark real customer online scenarios, use different concurrency, different sending frequencies, different input lengths and output length distributions to test service performance

Variable meaning: expandable_segments - enables the memory pool expansion segment function, that is, the virtual memory feature. Please see [昇腾环境变量参考](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/600/apiref/Envvariables/Envir_009.html) for more details.
```bash
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

The configuration of all machines should be consistent, except that the MIES_CONTAINER_IP of the environment variable is the local IP address.

export RANKTABLEFILE={rank_table_file.json 路径}

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

部署 DeepSeek-V3 模型用 W8A8 量化权重进行推理则至少需要 2 台 Atlas 800I A2 (8\*64G)。

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ5QZX> |

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

DeepSeek-V3 image version: 2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts
The name of the image after loading: swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \

      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \
      --device=/dev/davinci7 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      --device /dev/devmm_svm \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
      bash

```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
   docker exec -it {容器名称} bash

```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
   source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh

```
#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash
   export ATB_LLM_HCCL_ENABLE=1
   export ATB_LLM_COMM_BACKEND="hccl"
   export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=7200 # 该环境变量需要配置为整数，取值范围[120,7200]，单位 s
   双机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=16
   四机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=32
   export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0

```

## Deployment

### Service-based reasoning

[Usage Scenario] Benchmark real customer online scenarios, use different concurrency, different sending frequencies, different input lengths and output length distributions to test service performance

#### Configure service environment variables

Variable meaning: expandable_segments - enables the memory pool expansion segment function, that is, the virtual memory feature. Please see [昇腾环境变量参考](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/600/apiref/Envvariables/Envir_009.html) for more details.
```bash
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
```Servitization requires the `container_ip` field to be configured in `rank_table_file.json`.
The configuration of all machines should be consistent, except that the MIES_CONTAINER_IP of the environment variable is the local IP address.
```bash
export MIES_CONTAINER_IP={容器 ip 地址}
export RANKTABLEFILE={rank_table_file.json 路径}
```
#### Modify service parameters
```bash
cd /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/
vim conf/config.json
```Modify the following parameters

...

...
"modelName" : "DeepSeek-V3" # 不影响服务化拉起
"modelWeightPath" : "权重路径",
"worldSize":8,

#### Promote servitization
```bash
# 解决权重加载过慢问题
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
# 设置显存比
export NPU_MEMORY_FRACTION=0.95
# 拉起服务化
cd /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/
./bin/mindieservice_daemon
```After executing the command, all parameters used for this startup will first be printed, and then until the following output appears:
```text
Daemon start success!
```The service is considered to have started successfully.

#### Start a new client

Enter the same container and send a request to the server.

For more information, please refer to the official website information: [MindIE Service](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindie/100/mindieservice/servicedev/mindie_service0285.html).

#### Performance tuning example

The following will take the 800I-A3 stand-alone deployment of W8A8 weight as an example to introduce common performance tuning methods.

#### Mixed parallelism
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig" : [
      {
         "dp": 2,
         "tp": 8,
         "moe_tp": 4,
         "moe_ep": 4
      }
   ]
}
```To use dynamic EP, currently only `moe_tp = 1` is supported
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig" : [
      {
         "dp": 2,
         "tp": 8,
         "moe_tp": 1,
         "moe_ep": 16,
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "ep_level": 2
            }
         }
      },
   ]
}
```
#### MTP

The MTP feature improves performance more obviously for lower concurrency. The current version recommends MTP=1 or 2.
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "plugin_params": "{\"plugin_type\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\": 1}"
      }
   ]
}
```
#### NZ format KV Cache
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "kv_cache_options": {
                  "enable_nz": true
               }
            }
         }
      }
   ]
}
```
#### Weight prefetching
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "enable_oproj_prefetch": true,
               "enable_mlapo_prefetch": true
            }
         }
      }
   ]
}
```

### Hardware requirements

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ5QZX> |

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \
      --device=/dev/davinci7 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      --device /dev/devmm_svm \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
      bash

```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
   docker exec -it {容器名称} bash

```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
   source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh

```
#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash
   export ATB_LLM_HCCL_ENABLE=1
   export ATB_LLM_COMM_BACKEND="hccl"
   export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=7200 # 该环境变量需要配置为整数，取值范围[120,7200]，单位 s
   双机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=16
   四机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=32
   export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0

```

[Usage Scenario] Benchmark real customer online scenarios, use different concurrency, different sending frequencies, different input lengths and output length distributions to test service performance

Variable meaning: expandable_segments - enables the memory pool expansion segment function, that is, the virtual memory feature. Please see [昇腾环境变量参考](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/600/apiref/Envvariables/Envir_009.html) for more details.

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

部署 DeepSeek-V3 模型用 W8A8 量化权重进行推理则至少需要 2 台 Atlas 800I A2 (8\*64G)。

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ5QZX> |

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

DeepSeek-V3 image version: 2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts
The name of the image after loading: swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \
      --device=/dev/davinci7 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      --device /dev/devmm_svm \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
      bash

```
#### Enter the container

```sh

```
### Load image

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

部署 DeepSeek-V3 模型用 W8A8 量化权重进行推理则至少需要 2 台 Atlas 800I A2 (8\*64G)。

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ5QZX> |

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

DeepSeek-V3 image version: 2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts
The name of the image after loading: swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:2.0.T3-800I-A2-py311-openeuler24.03-lts.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \
      --device=/dev/davinci7 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      --device /dev/devmm_svm \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
      bash

```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
   docker exec -it {容器名称} bash

```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
   source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh

```
#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash
   export ATB_LLM_HCCL_ENABLE=1
   export ATB_LLM_COMM_BACKEND="hccl"
   export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=7200 # 该环境变量需要配置为整数，取值范围[120,7200]，单位 s
   双机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=16
   四机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=32
   export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0

```

[Usage Scenario] Benchmark real customer online scenarios, use different concurrency, different sending frequencies, different input lengths and output length distributions to test service performance

Variable meaning: expandable_segments - enables the memory pool expansion segment function, that is, the virtual memory feature. Please see [昇腾环境变量参考](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/600/apiref/Envvariables/Envir_009.html) for more details.
```bash

The configuration of all machines should be consistent, except that the MIES_CONTAINER_IP of the environment variable is the local IP address.

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

## Prerequisites

### Hardware requirements

### Weight

**Weight download**

#### FP8 original weight download

FP8 weights can be downloaded from the following sources:

| Model | HuggingFace | ModelScope |
|---|---|---|
| DeepSeek-V3 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3) |
| DeepSeek-V3-Base | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-Base/tree/main) | 暂无 |
| DeepSeek-V3-0324 | [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324/tree/main) | [ModelScope](https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324) |

> After downloading, please put it into the weight directory yourself. This path needs to be referenced in subsequent inference steps.

#### Weight conversion (Convert FP8 weights to BF16)

NPU side weight conversion

Note:

- DeepSeek officially does not provide a new weight conversion script for DeepSeek-V3, so the weight conversion script of DeepSeek-V2 is reused.
- If the user uses the script above to download the weights, there is no need to use the following git clone command and directly enter the weight conversion script directory.
```sh
git clone https://gitee.com/ascend/ModelZoo-PyTorch.git
```

```sh
cd ModelZoo-PyTorch/MindIE/LLM/DeepSeek/DeepSeek-V2/NPU_inference
```

```sh
python fp8_cast_bf16.py --input-fp8-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3} --output-bf16-hf-path {/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16}
```Currently, the npu conversion script will not automatically copy tokenizer and other files. You need to copy the original weight tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json and other files to the path after conversion.

Note:

- `/path/to/DeepSeek-V3` represents the original weight path of DeepSeek-V3,`/path/to/DeepSeek-V3-bf16` represents the new weight path after weight conversion.
- Due to the large weight of the model, please ensure that your disk has enough space to put down all the weights. For example, the weight of DeepSeek-V3 before conversion is about 640G,the weight after conversion is about 1.3T.
- When performing inference jobs, please also ensure that your device has enough space to load model weights and reserve space for inference calculations.

#### BF16 original weight download

You can also directly download the BF16 model weights through open source communities such as HuggingFace and ModelScope:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ2QZX> |
| modelscope | <ZXQ3QZX> |
| modelers | <ZXQ4QZX> |

The BF16 model weight link of DeepSeek-V3-0324 is:

| Source | Link |
|---|---|
| huggingface | <ZXQ5QZX> |

(See the original source for subsequent content)

## Installation

### Preparation for inference

- Modify the config.json file in the weight directory

Note: In this warehouse implementation, DeepSeek-V3 currently uses the DeepSeek_v3 code framework.

In a multi-machine scenario, rank_table_file.json needs to be configured. For specific methods, please refer to [Rank Table File 配置指南](../../../../../docs/zh/user_guide/user_manual/rank_table_file_configuration.md).

- Modify the model folder to belong to the group 1001 -HwHiAiUser belongs to the group (the container has Root permissions and can be ignored),the execution permissions are 750:
```sh
chown -R 1001:1001 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
chmod -R 750 {/path-to-weights/DeepSeek-V3}
```
### Load image

Requires mindie:2.0.T3 and later versions.

Go to [昇腾社区/开发资源](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to download the adaptation. You need to apply for permission before downloading the image. Wait patiently for the permission application to be approved,then download the corresponding image file according to the guide.

After completion, please use the `docker images` command to confirm to find the specific image name and label.
```bash
docker images
```Each component version is matched as follows:

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| MindIE | 2.0.T3 |
| CANN | 8.0.T63 |
| Pytorch | 6.0.T700 |
| MindStudio | Msit: br_noncom_MindStudio_8.0.0_POC_20251231 branch |
| Ascend HDK | 24.1.0 |

#### Start container

- Execute the following command to start the container (reference):
```sh
   docker run -itd --privileged --name= {容器名称} --net=host \
      --shm-size 500g \
      --device=/dev/davinci0 \
      --device=/dev/davinci1 \
      --device=/dev/davinci2 \
      --device=/dev/davinci3 \
      --device=/dev/davinci4 \
      --device=/dev/davinci5 \
      --device=/dev/davinci6 \
      --device=/dev/davinci7 \
      --device=/dev/davinci_manager \
      --device=/dev/hisi_hdc \
      --device /dev/devmm_svm \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver \
      -v /usr/local/Ascend/firmware:/usr/local/Ascend/firmware \
      -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \
      -v /usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/sbin \
      -v /etc/hccn.conf:/etc/hccn.conf \
      -v {/权重路径:/权重路径} \
      -v {/rank_table_file.json 路径:/rank_table_file.json 路径} \
      {swr.cn-south-1.myhuaweicloud.com/ascendhub/mindie:1.0.0-XXX-800I-A2-arm64-py3.11（根据加载的镜像名称修改）} \
      bash

```
#### Enter the container

- Execute the following command to enter the container (reference):
```sh
   docker exec -it {容器名称} bash

```
#### Set basic environment variables
```bash
   source /usr/local/Ascend/cann/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/nnal/atb/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/set_env.sh
   source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh

```
#### Enable communication environment variables
```bash
   export ATB_LLM_HCCL_ENABLE=1
   export ATB_LLM_COMM_BACKEND="hccl"
   export HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT=7200 # 该环境变量需要配置为整数，取值范围[120,7200]，单位 s
   双机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=16
   四机：
   export WORLD_SIZE=32
   export HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT=0

```

## Deployment

### Service-based reasoning

[Usage Scenario] Benchmark real customer online scenarios, use different concurrency, different sending frequencies, different input lengths and output length distributions to test service performance

#### Configure service environment variables

Variable meaning: expandable_segments - enables the memory pool expansion segment function, that is, the virtual memory feature. Please see [昇腾环境变量参考](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/Pytorch/600/apiref/Envvariables/Envir_009.html) for more details.
```bash
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True
```Servitization requires the `container_ip` field to be configured in `rank_table_file.json`.
The configuration of all machines should be consistent, except that the MIES_CONTAINER_IP of the environment variable is the local IP address.
```bash
export MIES_CONTAINER_IP={容器 ip 地址}
export RANKTABLEFILE={rank_table_file.json 路径}
```
#### Modify service parameters
```bash
cd /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/
vim conf/config.json
```Modify the following parameters
```json
"httpsEnabled" : false, # 如果网络环境不安全，不开启 HTTPS 通信，即“httpsEnabled”=“false”时，会存在较高的网络安全风险
...
"multiNodesInferEnabled" : true, # 开启多机推理
...
# 若不需要安全认证，则将以下两个参数设为 false
"interCommTLSEnabled" : false,
"interNodeTLSEnabled" : false,
...
"npudeviceIds" : [[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]],
...
"modelName" : "DeepSeek-V3" # 不影响服务化拉起
"modelWeightPath" : "权重路径",
"worldSize":8,
```Example: For reference only, please modify it according to the actual situation
```json

    "LogConfig" :

        "logLevel" : "Info",
        "logFileSize" : 20,
        "logFileNum" : 20,
        "logPath" : "logs/mindie-server.log"
    },

    "ServerConfig" :
    {
        "ipAddress" : "改成主节点 IP",
        "managementIpAddress" : "改成主节点 IP",
        "port" : 1025,
        "managementPort" : 1026,
        "metricsPort" : 1027,
        "allowAllZeroIpListening" : false,
        "maxLinkNum" : 1000, //如果是 4 机，建议 300

        "fullTextEnabled" : false,
        "tlsCaPath" : "security/ca/",
        "tlsCaFile" : ["ca.pem"],
        "tlsCert" : "security/certs/server.pem",
        "tlsPk" : "security/keys/server.key.pem",
        "tlsCrlPath" : "security/certs/",
        "tlsCrlFiles" : ["server_crl.pem"],
        "managementTlsCaFile" : ["management_ca.pem"],
        "managementTlsCert" : "security/certs/management/server.pem",
        "managementTlsPk" : "security/keys/management/server.key.pem",
        "managementTlsCrlPath" : "security/management/certs/",
        "managementTlsCrlFiles" : ["server_crl.pem"],
        "metricsTlsCaFile" : ["metrics_ca.pem"],
        "metricsTlsCert" : "security/certs/metrics/server.pem",
        "metricsTlsPk" : "security/keys/metrics/server.key.pem",
        "metricsTlsCrlPath" : "security/metrics/certs/",
        "metricsTlsCrlFiles" : ["server_crl.pem"],
        "inferMode" : "standard",
        "interCommTLSEnabled" : false,
        "interCommPort" : 1121,
        "interCommTlsCaPath" : "security/grpc/ca/",
        "interCommTlsCaFiles" : ["ca.pem"],
        "interCommTlsCert" : "security/grpc/certs/server.pem",
        "interCommPk" : "security/grpc/keys/server.key.pem",
        "interCommTlsCrlPath" : "security/grpc/certs/",
        "interCommTlsCrlFiles" : ["server_crl.pem"],
        "openAiSupport" : "vllm"
    },

    "BackendConfig" : {
        "backendName" : "mindieservice_llm_engine",
        "modelInstanceNumber" : 1,
        "npuDeviceIds" : [[0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]],
        "tokenizerProcessNumber" : 8,
        "multiNodesInferEnabled" : true,
        "multiNodesInferPort" : 1120,
        "interNodeTLSEnabled" : false,

        "interNodeTlsCrlPath" : "security/grpc/certs/",
        "interNodeTlsCrlFiles" : ["server_crl.pem"],
        "ModelDeployConfig" :
        {
            "maxSeqLen" : 10000,
            "maxInputTokenLen" : 2048,
            "truncation" : true,
            "ModelConfig" : [

            "decodePolicyType" : 0,

        }

```
#### Promote servitization
```bash
# 解决权重加载过慢问题
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
# 设置显存比
export NPU_MEMORY_FRACTION=0.95
# 拉起服务化
cd /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/
./bin/mindieservice_daemon
```After executing the command, all parameters used for this startup will first be printed, and then until the following output appears:
```text
Daemon start success!
```The service is considered to have started successfully.

#### Start a new client

Enter the same container and send a request to the server.

For more information, please refer to the official website information: [MindIE Service](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindie/100/mindieservice/servicedev/mindie_service0285.html).

#### Performance tuning example

The following will take the 800I-A3 stand-alone deployment of W8A8 weight as an example to introduce common performance tuning methods.

#### Mixed parallelism
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig" : [
      {
         "dp": 2,
         "tp": 8,
         "moe_tp": 4,
         "moe_ep": 4
      }
   ]
}
```To use dynamic EP, currently only `moe_tp = 1` is supported
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig" : [
      {
         "dp": 2,
         "tp": 8,
         "moe_tp": 1,
         "moe_ep": 16,
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "ep_level": 2
            }
         }
      },
   ]
}
```
#### MTP

The MTP feature improves performance more obviously for lower concurrency. The current version recommends MTP=1 or 2.
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "plugin_params": "{\"plugin_type\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\": 1}"
      }
   ]
}
```
#### NZ format KV Cache
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "kv_cache_options": {
                  "enable_nz": true
               }
            }
         }
      }
   ]
}
```
#### Weight prefetching
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "enable_oproj_prefetch": true,
               "enable_mlapo_prefetch": true
            }
         }
      }
   ]
}
```

#### Promote servitization
```bash
# 解决权重加载过慢问题
export OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
# 设置显存比
export NPU_MEMORY_FRACTION=0.95
# 拉起服务化
cd /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/
./bin/mindieservice_daemon
```After executing the command, all parameters used for this startup will first be printed, and then until the following output appears:
```text
Daemon start success!
```The service is considered to have started successfully.

#### Start a new client

Enter the same container and send a request to the server.

For more information, please refer to the official website information: [MindIE Service](https://www.hiascend.com/document/detail/zh/mindie/100/mindieservice/servicedev/mindie_service0285.html).

#### Performance tuning example

The following will take the 800I-A3 stand-alone deployment of W8A8 weight as an example to introduce common performance tuning methods.

#### Mixed parallelism
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig" : [
      {
         "dp": 2,
         "tp": 8,
         "moe_tp": 4,
         "moe_ep": 4
      }
   ]
}
```To use dynamic EP, currently only `moe_tp = 1` is supported
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig" : [
      {
         "dp": 2,
         "tp": 8,
         "moe_tp": 1,
         "moe_ep": 16,
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "ep_level": 2
            }
         }
      },
   ]
}
```
#### MTP

The MTP feature improves performance more obviously for lower concurrency. The current version recommends MTP=1 or 2.
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "plugin_params": "{\"plugin_type\":\"mtp\",\"num_speculative_tokens\": 1}"
      }
   ]
}
```
#### NZ format KV Cache
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "kv_cache_options": {
                  "enable_nz": true
               }
            }
         }
      }
   ]
}
```
#### Weight prefetching
``` json
{
   "ModelConfig": [
      {
         "models": {
            "deepseekv2": {
               "enable_oproj_prefetch": true,
               "enable_mlapo_prefetch": true
            }
         }
      }
   ]
}
```

| Prefix Cache | ✅ | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |  |  |  |
