对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ --device=/dev/davinci0:/dev/davinci0 \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager \ --device=/dev/ascend_manager \ --device=/dev/user_config \ -v /etc/sys_version.conf:/etc/sys_version.conf \ -v /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf:/etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf \ -v /etc/hdcBasic.cfg:/etc/hdcBasic.cfg \ -v /var/dmp_daemon:/var/dmp_daemon \ -v /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2:/usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2 \ -v /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so:/usr/lib64/libmmpa.so \ -v /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1:/usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1 \ -v /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9:/usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2 \ -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \ -v /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so:/usr/lib64/libstackcore.so \ -v /etc/slog.conf:/etc/slog.conf \ -v /var/slogd:/var/slogd \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64 \ -v /path-to-weights:/path-to-weights:ro \ mindie:3.0.0-300I-DUO-py311-openEuler24.03-lts bash ` **Table 1** Parameter description Parameter Description --pids-limit -1 means to lift the limit on the number of processes. When the , this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. If you use the model warehouse installation package, the path is the path after decompression of the installation package; if you use source code to compile, the path is `MindIE-LLM/examples/atb_models`; if you use a mirror to run, the path is `/usr/local/Ascend/atb-models`. |

## Installation

Instruct users to install the MindIE container image. Please ensure that the server can connect to the network.

#### Prerequisite [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E5%89%8D%E6%8F%90%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6)

- The NPU driver and firmware have been installed on the host machine. If it is not installed, download [固件与驱动](https://hiascend.com/hardware/firmware-drivers/community) and select the corresponding community version or commercial version of firmware and driver according to the product series and model. Please refer to the following command to install:
```bash
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --full --force
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run --full
```
- Users install Docker on the host machine by themselves (the version requirement is greater than or equal to 24.x.x). For the installation of Docker, see [安装Docker](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/docker_installation/).
- Before configuring the source, please ensure that the installation environment can connect to the network.

Description

For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, the operating system compatibility requirements of the host and container image are as follows:

- Ubuntu 22.04 host supports running Ubuntu 24.04 container image
- openEuler 22.03 host supports running openEuler 24.03 container image

Please select a compatible container image version based on the host operating system.

#### Get MindIE image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96mindie%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)

1. Click [昇腾镜像仓库链接](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to enter the MindIE image download page.
2. Click the login button in the upper right corner of the page and log in with your Huawei account (if you have not registered yet, please register first).
3. On the "Image Version" tab of the MindIE image download page, click the "Download Now" button in the "**Operation**" column behind the corresponding image according to your device form.
4. Download the image according to the image download operation guide page that pops up, as shown in [图1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#figure1). **Figure 1** Mirror download

#### Use image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)
1. Execute the following corresponding commands according to the device form to start the container. The container startup command is for reference only and can be modified according to your needs. The command parameters are introduced as shown in [表1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#table1). **Atlas 800I A2 Inference Server** `bash docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=500g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ -w /home \ --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci2:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci3:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \ --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \ --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \ -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \ -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \ -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \ -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \ {IMAGE_ID} bash` Description `{IMAGE_ID}` is the image ID. After the image is installed, execute the `docker images` command to view the corresponding ID. Just replace it in the above command. For the `--device` parameter, the mounting permission is set to `rwm` instead of `rw` or `r` with smaller permissions. information and run the MindIE business normallybut if the mounted If the npu (corresponding to `davinci_xxx_` in the mount option, for example, `npu0` corresponds to `davinci0`) is occupied by other tasks, using the `npu-smi` command will print an error and  if the mount permission is set to `rw`, after entering the container, an error will be printed when using the `npu-smi` command,the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). **Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module** When starting the container, you need to additionally mount some driver libraries and configuration files that npu-smi depends on. If it is not mounted, executing npu-smi related commands in the container may fail. The startup commands for different container image operating systems are as follows: Ubuntu 24.04 image: `docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=1g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ --device=/dev/davinci0:/dev/davinci0 \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager \ --device=/dev/ascend_manager \ --device=/dev/user_config \ -v /etc/sys_version.conf:/etc/sys_version.conf \ -v /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf:/etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf \ -v /etc/hdcBasic.cfg:/etc/hdcBasic.cfg \ -v /var/dmp_daemon:/var/dmp_daemon \ -v /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2:/usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2 \ -v /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so:/usr/lib64/libmmpa.so \ -v /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1:/usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1 \ -v /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9:/usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2 \ -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \ -v /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so:/usr/lib64/libstackcore.so \ -v /etc/slog.conf:/etc/slog.conf \ -v /var/slogd:/var/slogd \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64 \ -v /path-to-weights:/path-to-weights:ro \ mindie:3.0.0-Atlas 800I A2 inference server uses the Alibaba Cloud Linux 3.2104 U10 operating system, this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.

````shell
  pip install -r ${llm_path}/requirements/models/requirements_qwen2_vl.txt

```
#### Debugging suggestions

- **Log debugging suggestions when encountering unknown errors**
  If you encounter unknown errors or abnormalities during operation, it is recommended to enable log printing to assist in troubleshooting.
  Execute the following command in the terminal to set environment variables:
```shell
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_FILE=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_LEVEL=info

```After enabling this environment variable, the system log will be output to the terminal (standard output) and synchronously saved in the '/root/mindie' directory to facilitate subsequent problem location and analysis.

#### Pure model inference

- Necessary input instructions
  - `--model_path`: local weight path, must be entered
  - `--input_image`: The local file path of the picture or video
  - `--dataset_path`: local folder path of pictures or videos
  - `--max_batch_size` : Batch Size
  - `--max_input_length`: Maximum input length (need to consider the resolution of the input image and the length of the video)
  - `--max_output_length`: Maximum output length
  - `--input_text`: input prompt
  - `--shm_name_save_path`: The saving path of the shared memory can be set to an accessible txt file.
  - For other supported inference parameters, please refer to the `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.py` file
- If you need to modify the number of TP cards, modify the environment in the `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh` file to change `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` to the specified card number.
```shell
    export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3

```
- Open model log
```shell
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_FILE=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_LEVEL=info

```
- Execute startup script `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh
````shell
    bash ${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh --model_path MODEL_PATH --input_image INPUT_IMAGE

```or
```shell
    bash ${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh --model_path MODEL_PATH --dataset_path DATASET_PATH

```
- Description of environment variables (the following are the environment variables configured in the run_pa.sh startup script)
  -`export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7`
    - Specify the logical NPU cores available on the current machine. Use commas to connect multiple cores.
    - For the core ID query method, please refer to the [Environment Variables Related to Startup Scripts] chapter of [此 README 文件](../../README.md)
    - Refer to the "Feature Matrix" for the number of cores supported by each model.
  -`export MASTER_PORT=20036`
    - Set up inter-card communication port
    - Use port 20036 by default
    - The purpose is to avoid communication conflicts when the same machine runs multiple multi-card models at the same time.
    - The recommended port range when setting is: 20000-20050
  - The following environment variables are related to performance and memory optimization and generally do not need to be modified.
```shell
    export INF_NAN_MODE_ENABLE=0
    export ATB_OPERATION_EXECUTE_ASYNC=1
    export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
    export ATB_CONVERT_NCHW_TO_ND=1

```

          {"type": "text", "text": "Explain the contents of the picture."},
          {
              "type": "image_url",
              "image_url": ${图片路径}
          }
      ],
      "max_tokens": 512,
      "do_sample": false,
      "stream": false,
      "model": "qwen2_vl"
  }'

```

- The supported world sizes shown in the table are recommended configurations. In actual operation, the upper limit of the video memory of a single card and the length of the input sequence need to be considered.
- Inference loads BF16 weights by default. If you want to use FP16 format for inference, you need to change the value of the `torch_dtype` attribute of the config.json file under the weight path to `float16`.

| Variable name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| llm_path | Model warehouse path. If you use the model warehouse installation package, the path is the path after decompression of the installation package; if you use source code to compile, the path is `MindIE-LLM/examples/atb_models`; if you use a mirror to run, the path is `/usr/local/Ascend/atb-models`. |

## Installation

Guide users to install MindIE on a physical machine. Please choose whl package or run package to install according to the actual situation.

This section introduces the steps to install MindIE through whl package. The following takes installing MindIE LLM as an example.

1. To ensure the security of file permissions after installation, please execute the following command to set permissions: `old_umask=$(umask) umask 027 `
2. Execute the following command to install the whl package. `pip install mindie_llm-{version}-{python_tag}-{platform_tag}.whl --no-deps `

!!! note "Description"
```bash
   - 上方以mindie_llm包为例，如安装MindIE Motor或MindIE SD，请替换为对应的whl包名。
   - 如果需要使用源码编译安装，请跳转到对应代码仓里获取编译指导。以MindIE-LLM为例，编译指导请[单击](../../../developer_guide/build_guide_llm.md)。
```1. After the installation is completed, if the following information is printed, the software installation is successful: `Successfully installed xxx ` `xxx` represents the actual software package name installed.
2. (Optional) Run the following command to query the software version number and installation path.
```bash
pip show mindie_llm
```

```bash
若python版本是3.11，则默认安装路径为：`/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages`
```1. Execute the following command to restore permissions. `umask $old_umask `

This article introduces the steps to install MindIE through the run package method. This method will install the components of MindIE Motor, MindIE LLM and MindIE SD in sequence. The path of the component package is under the sub-path of MindIE.

1. Log in to the installation environment as the installation user of the CANN software package.
2. Upload the obtained MindIE software package to any path in the installation environment (such as /home/package).
3. Enter the path where the software package is located. `cd /home/package `
4. Add executable permissions to the software package. `chmod +x 软件包名.run ` **Software package name.run** indicates the development kit package Ascend-mindie_\_linux-\_\.run. Please replace it according to the actual package name.
5. Run the following command to add the environment variables of the ascend-toolkit package. (Take the root user as an example. The following is the default installation path for the root user.) `source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh `
6. Run the following command to verify the consistency and completeness of the software package installation file. `./软件包名.run --check `
7. Execute the following command to install the software (the following command supports parameters such as `--install-path=<path>`, please see [软件包参数说明](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/faq_and_appendixes/software_package_options/) for detailed parameter description). "/home/{current user name}/Ascend" The detailed log path of the software package installation is as follows. Root user: "/var/log/mindie_log/mindie_install.log" Non-root user: "/home/{current user name}/var/log/mindie_log/mindie_install.log" During the installation process, the aie_tmp_source folder will be temporarily generated in the current directory and will be deleted after the installation is completed. If there is currently a folder with the same name, it will be deleted after installation. By executing the above command, you agree to the terms and conditions of [华为企业业务最终用户许可协议（EULA）](https://e.huawei.com/cn/about/eula) by default. After the installation is completed, if the following information is printed, the software installation is successful: `xxx install success ` `xxx` represents the actual software package name installed.
8. (Optional) Run the following command to query the software version number. Take the default installation path as an example:
```bash
cat /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/version.info
```1. Configure environment variables Currently, a process-level environment variable setting script is provided for users to reference in the process to automatically complete environment variable settings. It will automatically expire after the user process ends. Examples are as follows: Configure environment variables in the default installation path of root users: `source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh ` Configure environment variables in the default installation path of non-root users: `source /home/{当前用户名}/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh ` Users can also set permanent environment variables by modifying the ~/.bashrc file. The operation is as follows: `a. 以运行用户在任意目录下执行`vi \~/.bashrc`命令，打开.bashrc文件，在文件最后一行后面添加上述内容。 b. 执行`:wq!`命令保存文件并退出。 c. 执行`source \~/.bashrc`命令使其立即生效。 `

    - Set up inter-card communication port
    - Use port 20036 by default
    - The purpose is to avoid communication conflicts when the same machine runs multiple multi-card models at the same time.

  - The following environment variables are related to performance and memory optimization and generally do not need to be modified.

    export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1

```

## Installation

### Mirror installation [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85)

Instruct users to install the MindIE container image. Please ensure that the server can connect to the network.

#### Prerequisite [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E5%89%8D%E6%8F%90%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6)

- The NPU driver and firmware have been installed on the host machine. If it is not installed, download [固件与驱动](https://hiascend.com/hardware/firmware-drivers/community) and select the corresponding community version or commercial version of firmware and driver according to the product series and model. Please refer to the following command to install:
```bash
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --full --force
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run --full
```
- Users install Docker on the host machine by themselves (the version requirement is greater than or equal to 24.x.x). For the installation of Docker, see [安装Docker](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/docker_installation/).
- Before configuring the source, please ensure that the installation environment can connect to the network.

Description

For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, the operating system compatibility requirements of the host and container image are as follows:

- Ubuntu 22.04 host supports running Ubuntu 24.04 container image
- openEuler 22.03 host supports running openEuler 24.03 container image

Please select a compatible container image version based on the host operating system.

#### Get MindIE image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96mindie%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)

1. Click [昇腾镜像仓库链接](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to enter the MindIE image download page.
2. Click the login button in the upper right corner of the page and log in with your Huawei account (if you have not registered yet, please register first).
3. On the "Image Version" tab of the MindIE image download page, click the "Download Now" button in the "**Operation**" column behind the corresponding image according to your device form.
4. Download the image according to the image download operation guide page that pops up, as shown in [图1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#figure1). **Figure 1** Mirror download

#### Use image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)
1. Execute the following corresponding commands according to the device form to start the container. The container startup command is for reference only and can be modified according to your needs. The command parameters are introduced as shown in [表1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#table1). **Atlas 800I A3 Inference Server** `bash docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=500g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ -w /home \ --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci2:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci3:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \ --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \ --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \ -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \ -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \ -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \ -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \ {IMAGE_ID} bash` Description `{IMAGE_ID}` is the image ID. After the image is installed, execute the `docker images` command to view the corresponding ID. Just replace it in the above command. For the `--device` parameter, the mounting permission is set to `rwm` instead of `rw` or `r` with smaller permissions. information and run the MindIE business normally but if the mounted If the npu (corresponding to `davinci_xxx_` in the mount option, for example, `npu0` corresponds to `davinci0`) is occupied by other tasks, using the `npu-smi` command will print an error and the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). >- For the Atlas 800I A3 super node server, if the mount permission is set to `rw`, after entering the container, an error will be printed when using the `npu-smi` command,the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). **Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module** When starting the container, you need to additionally mount some driver libraries and configuration files that npu-smi depends on. If it is not mounted, executing npu-smi related commands in the container may fail. The startup commands for different container image operating systems are as follows: Ubuntu 24.04 image: `docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=1g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，若业务最大并发数较高， this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `
3. Install dependencies. Before using the model for inference, you need to install the corresponding dependencies. The path of the dependency installation file (requirements_*xxx*.txt) of each model is /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models. Taking the LLaMA3 series model as an example, use the following command to install the dependencies. `cd /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models pip3 install -r requirements_llama3.txt `
4. Execute the following command to enable MindIE log printing. `export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT="true" `
5. Use models for inference. Take the LLaMA3 series model as an example. For details, please refer to the instructions in "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH/examples/models/llama3/README.md" in the container. For other models, please refer to [模型列表](https://www.hiascend.com/software/mindie/modellist). Execute the following command for inference: `cd $ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights # 请修改权重路径 ` Print the default question "Question" and the inference result "Answer", as shown below: `2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Question[0]: What's deep learning? 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Answer[0]: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks to learn from data. Neural networks are 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Generate[0] token num: (0, 20) ` If the user wants to customize the input question, he can use the "--input_texts" parameter setting, such as: `python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights --input_texts "What is deep learning?" # 请修改权重路径 ` Note "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH" has been set in ".bashrc", there is no need to set it yourself.
6. MindIE Motor is an inference service-oriented framework for general model scenarios. It provides inference service-oriented capabilities through an open and scalable inference service-oriented platform architecture, supports docking with the industry's mainstream inference framework interfaces,meets the high-performance inference requirements of large language models. For the method of connecting to Motor, please refer to [快速入门](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/quick_start/quick_start/#%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86).

## Installation

### Physical machine installation method [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/installation_on_a_physical_machine/#%E7%89%A9%E7%90%86%E6%9C%BA%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E6%96%B9%E5%BC%8F)

Guide users to install MindIE on a physical machine. Please choose whl package or run package to install according to the actual situation.

#### whl package installation method [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/installation_on_a_physical_machine/#whl%E5%8C%85%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E6%96%B9%E5%BC%8F)

This section introduces the steps to install MindIE through whl package. The following takes installing MindIE LLM as an example.

1. To ensure the security of file permissions after installation, please execute the following command to set permissions: `old_umask=$(umask) umask 027 `
2. Execute the following command to install the whl package. `pip install mindie_llm-{version}-{python_tag}-{platform_tag}.whl --no-deps `

!!! note "Description"
```bash
   - 上方以mindie_llm包为例，如安装MindIE Motor或MindIE SD，请替换为对应的whl包名。
   - 如果需要使用源码编译安装，请跳转到对应代码仓里获取编译指导。以MindIE-LLM为例，编译指导请[单击](../../../developer_guide/build_guide_llm.md)。
```1. After the installation is completed, if the following information is printed, the software installation is successful: `Successfully installed xxx ` `xxx` represents the actual software package name installed.
2. (Optional) Run the following command to query the software version number and installation path.
```bash
pip show mindie_llm
```

```bash
若python版本是3.11，则默认安装路径为：`/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages`
```1. Execute the following command to restore permissions. `umask $old_umask `

#### run package installation method [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/installation_on_a_physical_machine/#run%E5%8C%85%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85%E6%96%B9%E5%BC%8F)

This article introduces the steps to install MindIE through the run package method. This method will install the components of MindIE Motor, MindIE LLM and MindIE SD in sequence. The path of the component package is under the sub-path of MindIE.

1. Log in to the installation environment as the installation user of the CANN software package.
2. Upload the obtained MindIE software package to any path in the installation environment (such as /home/package).
3. Enter the path where the software package is located. `cd /home/package `
4. Add executable permissions to the software package. `chmod +x 软件包名.run ` **Software package name.run** indicates the development kit package Ascend-mindie_\_linux-\_\.run. Please replace it according to the actual package name.
5. Run the following command to add the environment variables of the ascend-toolkit package. (Take the root user as an example. The following is the default installation path for the root user.) `source /usr/local/Ascend/ascend-toolkit/set_env.sh `
6. Run the following command to verify the consistency and completeness of the software package installation file. `./软件包名.run --check `
7. Execute the following command to install the software (the following command supports parameters such as `--install-path=<path>`, please see [软件包参数说明](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/faq_and_appendixes/software_package_options/) for detailed parameter description). "/home/{current user name}/Ascend" The detailed log path of the software package installation is as follows. Root user: "/var/log/mindie_log/mindie_install.log" Non-root user: "/home/{current user name}/var/log/mindie_log/mindie_install.log" During the installation process, the aie_tmp_source folder will be temporarily generated in the current directory and will be deleted after the installation is completed. If there is currently a folder with the same name, it will be deleted after installation. By executing the above command, you agree to the terms and conditions of [华为企业业务最终用户许可协议（EULA）](https://e.huawei.com/cn/about/eula) by default. After the installation is completed, if the following information is printed, the software installation is successful: `xxx install success ` `xxx` represents the actual software package name installed.
8. (Optional) Run the following command to query the software version number. Take the default installation path as an example:
```bash
cat /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/version.info
```1. Configure environment variables Currently, a process-level environment variable setting script is provided for users to reference in the process to automatically complete environment variable settings. It will automatically expire after the user process ends. Examples are as follows: Configure environment variables in the default installation path of root users: `source /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh ` Configure environment variables in the default installation path of non-root users: `source /home/{当前用户名}/Ascend/mindie/set_env.sh ` Users can also set permanent environment variables by modifying the ~/.bashrc file. The operation is as follows: `a. 以运行用户在任意目录下执行`vi \~/.bashrc`命令，打开.bashrc文件，在文件最后一行后面添加上述内容。 b. 执行`:wq!`命令保存文件并退出。 c. 执行`source \~/.bashrc`命令使其立即生效。 `

#### Debugging suggestions

- **Log debugging suggestions when encountering unknown errors**
  If you encounter unknown errors or abnormalities during operation, it is recommended to enable log printing to assist in troubleshooting.
  Execute the following command in the terminal to set environment variables:
```shell
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_FILE=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_LEVEL=info

```After enabling this environment variable, the system log will be output to the terminal (standard output) and synchronously saved in the '/root/mindie' directory to facilitate subsequent problem location and analysis.

#### Pure model inference

- Necessary input instructions
  - `--model_path`: local weight path, must be entered
  - `--input_image`: The local file path of the picture or video
  - `--dataset_path`: local folder path of pictures or videos
  - `--max_batch_size` : Batch Size
  - `--max_input_length`: Maximum input length (need to consider the resolution of the input image and the length of the video)
  - `--max_output_length`: Maximum output length
  - `--input_text`: input prompt
  - `--shm_name_save_path`: The saving path of the shared memory can be set to an accessible txt file.
  - For other supported inference parameters, please refer to the `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.py` file
- If you need to modify the number of TP cards, modify the environment in the `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh` file to change `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` to the specified card number.
```shell
    export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3

```

  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_FILE=1

```

````shell
    bash ${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh --model_path MODEL_PATH --input_image INPUT_IMAGE

```
- Description of environment variables (the following are the environment variables configured in the run_pa.sh startup script)
  -`export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7`
    - Specify the logical NPU cores available on the current machine. Use commas to connect multiple cores.
    - For the core ID query method, please refer to the [Environment Variables Related to Startup Scripts] chapter of [此 README 文件](../../README.md)
    - Refer to the "Feature Matrix" for the number of cores supported by each model.
  -`export MASTER_PORT=20036`
    - Set up inter-card communication port
    - Use port 20036 by default
    - The purpose is to avoid communication conflicts when the same machine runs multiple multi-card models at the same time.
    - The recommended port range when setting is: 20000-20050
  - The following environment variables are related to performance and memory optimization and generally do not need to be modified.

- Inference loads BF16 weights by default. If you want to use FP16 format for inference, you need to change the value of the `torch_dtype` attribute of the config.json file under the weight path to `float16`.

| Variable name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| llm_path | Model warehouse path. If you use the model warehouse installation package, the path is the path after decompression of the installation package; if you use source code to compile, the path is `MindIE-LLM/examples/atb_models`; if you use a mirror to run, the path is `/usr/local/Ascend/atb-models`. |

## Installation

Instruct users to install the MindIE container image. Please ensure that the server can connect to the network.

#### Prerequisite [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E5%89%8D%E6%8F%90%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6)

- The NPU driver and firmware have been installed on the host machine. If it is not installed, download [固件与驱动](https://hiascend.com/hardware/firmware-drivers/community) and select the corresponding community version or commercial version of firmware and driver according to the product series and model. Please refer to the following command to install:
```bash
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --full --force
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run --full
```
- Users install Docker on the host machine by themselves (the version requirement is greater than or equal to 24.x.x). For the installation of Docker, see [安装Docker](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/docker_installation/).
- Before configuring the source, please ensure that the installation environment can connect to the network.

Description

For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, the operating system compatibility requirements of the host and container image are as follows:

- Ubuntu 22.04 host supports running Ubuntu 24.04 container image
- openEuler 22.03 host supports running openEuler 24.03 container image

Please select a compatible container image version based on the host operating system.

#### Get MindIE image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96mindie%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)

1. Click [昇腾镜像仓库链接](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to enter the MindIE image download page.
2. Click the login button in the upper right corner of the page and log in with your Huawei account (if you have not registered yet, please register first).
3. On the "Image Version" tab of the MindIE image download page, click the "Download Now" button in the "**Operation**" column behind the corresponding image according to your device form.
4. Download the image according to the image download operation guide page that pops up, as shown in [图1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#figure1). **Figure 1** Mirror download

#### Use image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)
1. Execute the following corresponding commands according to the device form to start the container. The container startup command is for reference only and can be modified according to your needs. The command parameters are introduced as shown in [表1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#table1). **Atlas 800I A2 Inference Server** `bash docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=500g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ -w /home \ --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci2:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci3:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \ --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \ --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \ -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \ -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \ -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \ -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \ {IMAGE_ID} bash` Description `{IMAGE_ID}` is the image ID. After the image is installed, execute the `docker images` command to view the corresponding ID. Just replace it in the above command. For the `--device` parameter, the mounting permission is set to `rwm` instead of `rw` or `r` with smaller permissions. information and run the MindIE business normallybut if the mounted If the npu (corresponding to `davinci_xxx_` in the mount option, for example, `npu0` corresponds to `davinci0`) is occupied by other tasks, using the `npu-smi` command will print an error and  if the mount permission is set to `rw`, after entering the container, an error will be printed when using the `npu-smi` command,the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). **Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module** When starting the container, you need to additionally mount some driver libraries and configuration files that npu-smi depends on. If it is not mounted, executing npu-smi related commands in the container may fail. The startup commands for different container image operating systems are as follows: Ubuntu 24.04 image: `docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=1g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ --device=/dev/davinci0:/dev/davinci0 \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager \ --device=/dev/ascend_manager \ --device=/dev/user_config \ -v /etc/sys_version.conf:/etc/sys_version.conf \ -v /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf:/etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf \ -v /etc/hdcBasic.cfg:/etc/hdcBasic.cfg \ -v /var/dmp_daemon:/var/dmp_daemon \ -v /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2:/usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2 \ -v /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so:/usr/lib64/libmmpa.so \ -v /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1:/usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1 \ -v /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9:/usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2 \ -v /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi:/usr/local/sbin/npu-smi \ -v /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so:/usr/lib64/libstackcore.so \ -v /etc/slog.conf:/etc/slog.conf \ -v /var/slogd:/var/slogd \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64:/usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64 \ -v /path-to-weights:/path-to-weights:ro \ mindie:3.0.0-Atlas 800I A2 inference server uses the Alibaba Cloud Linux 3.2104 U10 operating system, this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `
3. Install dependencies. Before using the model for inference, you need to install the corresponding dependencies. The path of the dependency installation file (requirements_*xxx*.txt) of each model is /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models. Taking the LLaMA3 series model as an example, use the following command to install the dependencies. `cd /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models pip3 install -r requirements_llama3.txt `
4. Execute the following command to enable MindIE log printing. `export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT="true" `
5. Use models for inference. Take the LLaMA3 series model as an example. For details, please refer to the instructions in "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH/examples/models/llama3/README.md" in the container. For other models, please refer to [模型列表](https://www.hiascend.com/software/mindie/modellist). Execute the following command for inference: `cd $ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights # 请修改权重路径 ` Print the default question "Question" and the inference result "Answer", as shown below: `2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Question[0]: What's deep learning? 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Answer[0]: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks to learn from data. Neural networks are 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Generate[0] token num: (0, 20) ` If the user wants to customize the input question, he can use the "--input_texts" parameter setting, such as: `python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights --input_texts "What is deep learning?" # 请修改权重路径 ` Note "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH" has been set in ".bashrc", there is no need to set it yourself.
6. MindIE Motor is an inference service-oriented framework for general model scenarios. It provides inference service-oriented capabilities through an open and scalable inference service-oriented platform architecture, supports docking with the industry's mainstream inference framework interfaces,meets the high-performance inference requirements of large language models. For the method of connecting to Motor, please refer to [快速入门](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/quick_start/quick_start/#%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E6%8E%A8%E7%90%86).

#### Install dependencies- Toolkit, MindIE/ATB, ATB-SPEED, etc., refer to [此 README 文件](../../../README.md), which is generally installed by default in the image package.
- Install Python and other third-party library dependencies, refer to [requirements_qwen2_vl.txt](../../../requirements/models/requirements_qwen2_vl.txt), pay attention to `transformers == 4.49.0
````shell
  pip install -r ${llm_path}/requirements/models/requirements_qwen2_vl.txt

```
#### Debugging suggestions

- **Log debugging suggestions when encountering unknown errors**
  If you encounter unknown errors or abnormalities during operation, it is recommended to enable log printing to assist in troubleshooting.
  Execute the following command in the terminal to set environment variables:
```shell
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_FILE=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_LEVEL=info

```After enabling this environment variable, the system log will be output to the terminal (standard output) and synchronously saved in the '/root/mindie' directory to facilitate subsequent problem location and analysis.

#### Pure model inference

- Necessary input instructions
  - `--model_path`: local weight path, must be entered
  - `--input_image`: The local file path of the picture or video
  - `--dataset_path`: local folder path of pictures or videos
  - `--max_batch_size` : Batch Size
  - `--max_input_length`: Maximum input length (need to consider the resolution of the input image and the length of the video)
  - `--max_output_length`: Maximum output length
  - `--input_text`: input prompt
  - `--shm_name_save_path`: The saving path of the shared memory can be set to an accessible txt file.
  - For other supported inference parameters, please refer to the `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.py` file
- If you need to modify the number of TP cards, modify the environment in the `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh` file to change `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES` to the specified card number.
```shell
    export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3

```
- Open model log
```shell
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_TO_FILE=1
  export MINDIE_LOG_LEVEL=info

```
- Execute startup script `${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh
````shell
    bash ${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh --model_path MODEL_PATH --input_image INPUT_IMAGE

```or
```shell
    bash ${llm_path}/examples/models/qwen2_vl/run_pa.sh --model_path MODEL_PATH --dataset_path DATASET_PATH

```
- Description of environment variables (the following are the environment variables configured in the run_pa.sh startup script)
  -`export ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7`
    - Specify the logical NPU cores available on the current machine. Use commas to connect multiple cores.
    - For the core ID query method, please refer to the [Environment Variables Related to Startup Scripts] chapter of [此 README 文件](../../README.md)
    - Refer to the "Feature Matrix" for the number of cores supported by each model.
  -`export MASTER_PORT=20036`
    - Set up inter-card communication port
    - Use port 20036 by default
    - The purpose is to avoid communication conflicts when the same machine runs multiple multi-card models at the same time.
    - The recommended port range when setting is: 20000-20050
  - The following environment variables are related to performance and memory optimization and generally do not need to be modified.
```shell
    export INF_NAN_MODE_ENABLE=0
    export ATB_OPERATION_EXECUTE_ASYNC=1
    export TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=1
    export ATB_CONVERT_NCHW_TO_ND=1

```
#### Service-based reasoning

- Taking the containerized deployment `MindIE` as an example, open the `MindIE-Service` configuration file `config.json
````shell
  vim /usr/local/Ascend/mindie/latest/mindie-service/conf/config.json

```
- Modify the `MindIE-Service` configuration file `config.json`, taking `Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct` and `Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct` as examples. In the 800I A2 environment, the following configuration is recommended. Please modify `modelWeightPath` to the actual weight path:

  - **Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct**
```json
  {
      "ServerConfig": {
          "port" : 1025,
          "managementPort" : 1026,
          "httpsEnabled": false,
      },
      "BackendConfig": {
          "npuDeviceIds": [
              [0,1]
          ],
          "ModelDeployConfig": {
              "maxSeqLen": 32768,
              "maxInputTokenLen": 32768,
              "ModelConfig": [
                  {
                      "modelInstanceType": "Standard",
                      "modelName": "qwen2_vl",
                      "modelWeightPath": "/data/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct",
                      "worldSize": 2,
                      "npuMemSize": 10, #KV Cache 的显存大小，单位是 GB，请勿设置为-1，需要给 vit 预留空间。
                  }
              ]
          },
          "ScheduleConfig": {
              "maxPrefillTokens": 32768,
          }
      }
  }

```
- **Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct**
```json
  {
      "ServerConfig": {
          "port" : 1025,
          "managementPort" : 1026,
          "httpsEnabled": false,
      },
      "BackendConfig": {
          "npuDeviceIds": [
              [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]
          ],
          "ModelDeployConfig": {
              "maxSeqLen": 32768,
              "maxInputTokenLen": 32768,
              "ModelConfig": [
                  {
                      "modelInstanceType": "Standard",
                      "modelName": "qwen2_vl",
                      "modelWeightPath": "/data/Qwen2-VL-72B-Instruct",
                      "worldSize": 8,
                      "npuMemSize": 10, #KV Cache 的显存大小，单位是 GB，请勿设置为-1，需要给 vit 预留空间。
                  }
              ]
          },
          "ScheduleConfig": {
              "maxPrefillTokens": 65536,
          }
      }
  }

```
- **QvQ**

  {
      "ServerConfig": {
          "port" : 1025,
          "managementPort" : 1026,
          "httpsEnabled": false,
      },
      "BackendConfig": {
          "npuDeviceIds": [
              [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]
          ],
          "ModelDeployConfig": {

- Create a new Docker terminal session and send a curl request to complete the inference. Take the OpenAI interface and vLLM interface as an example

- Inference loads BF16 weights by default. If you want to use FP16 format for inference, you need to change the value of the `torch_dtype` attribute of the config.json file under the weight path to `float16`.

  - `--model_path`: local weight path, must be entered
  - `--input_image`: The local file path of the picture or video
  - `--dataset_path`: local folder path of pictures or videos
  - `--max_batch_size` : Batch Size
  - `--max_input_length`: Maximum input length (need to consider the resolution of the input image and the length of the video)
  - `--max_output_length`: Maximum output length
  - `--input_text`: input prompt
  - `--shm_name_save_path`: The saving path of the shared memory can be set to an accessible txt file.

## Installation

### Mirror installation [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F%E5%AE%89%E8%A3%85)

Instruct users to install the MindIE container image. Please ensure that the server can connect to the network.

#### Prerequisite [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E5%89%8D%E6%8F%90%E6%9D%A1%E4%BB%B6)

- The NPU driver and firmware have been installed on the host machine. If it is not installed, download [固件与驱动](https://hiascend.com/hardware/firmware-drivers/community) and select the corresponding community version or commercial version of firmware and driver according to the product series and model. Please refer to the following command to install:
```bash
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run
chmod +x Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-driver_<version>_linux-<arch>.run --full --force
./Ascend-hdk-<chip_type>-npu-firmware_<version>.run --full
```
- Users install Docker on the host machine by themselves (the version requirement is greater than or equal to 24.x.x). For the installation of Docker, see [安装Docker](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/docker_installation/).
- Before configuring the source, please ensure that the installation environment can connect to the network.

Description

For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, the operating system compatibility requirements of the host and container image are as follows:

- Ubuntu 22.04 host supports running Ubuntu 24.04 container image
- openEuler 22.03 host supports running openEuler 24.03 container image

Please select a compatible container image version based on the host operating system.

#### Get MindIE image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96mindie%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)

1. Click [昇腾镜像仓库链接](https://www.hiascend.com/developer/ascendhub/detail/af85b724a7e5469ebd7ea13c3439d48f) to enter the MindIE image download page.
2. Click the login button in the upper right corner of the page and log in with your Huawei account (if you have not registered yet, please register first).
3. On the "Image Version" tab of the MindIE image download page, click the "Download Now" button in the "**Operation**" column behind the corresponding image according to your device form.
4. Download the image according to the image download operation guide page that pops up, as shown in [图1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#figure1). **Figure 1** Mirror download

#### Use image [](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%E9%95%9C%E5%83%8F)
1. Execute the following corresponding commands according to the device form to start the container. The container startup command is for reference only and can be modified according to your needs. The command parameters are introduced as shown in [表1](https://mindie-llm-doc.readthedocs.io/zh-cn/latest/user_guide/install/source/image_usage_guide/#table1). **Atlas 800I A3 Inference Server** `bash docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=500g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，--shm-size建议设置不小于100g --name <container-name> \ -w /home \ --device=/dev/davinci0:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci1:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci2:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci3:rwm \ --device=/dev/davinci_manager:rwm \ --device=/dev/hisi_hdc:rwm \ --device=/dev/devmm_svm:rwm \ -v /usr/local/Ascend/driver:/usr/local/Ascend/driver:ro \ -v /usr/local/dcmi:/usr/local/dcmi:ro \ -v /usr/local/bin/npu-smi:/usr/local/bin/npu-smi:ro \ -v /usr/local/sbin/:/usr/local/sbin:ro \ -v /home/weight:/home/weight:ro \ {IMAGE_ID} bash` Description `{IMAGE_ID}` is the image ID. After the image is installed, execute the `docker images` command to view the corresponding ID. Just replace it in the above command. For the `--device` parameter, the mounting permission is set to `rwm` instead of `rw` or `r` with smaller permissions. information and run the MindIE business normally but if the mounted If the npu (corresponding to `davinci_xxx_` in the mount option, for example, `npu0` corresponds to `davinci0`) is occupied by other tasks, using the `npu-smi` command will print an error and the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). >- For the Atlas 800I A3 super node server, if the mount permission is set to `rw`, after entering the container, an error will be printed when using the `npu-smi` command,the MindIE task cannot be run (`torch.npu.set_device()` will fail at this time). **Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module** When starting the container, you need to additionally mount some driver libraries and configuration files that npu-smi depends on. If it is not mounted, executing npu-smi related commands in the container may fail. The startup commands for different container image operating systems are as follows: Ubuntu 24.04 image: `docker run -it -d --net=host --shm-size=1g \ # 对于多模态理解模型，若业务最大并发数较高，若业务最大并发数较高， this parameter must be used in the start container command to lift the limit on the number of processes. -it means starting an interactive terminal (-i) and connecting it to the standard input and output (-t) of the container, enabling interaction with the inside of the container, such as running command line operations. -d indicates that the container will run in background mode, that is, the container is started in the background. Using this parameter will not block the current terminal operation,you can continue to perform other operations after starting the container. --net indicates that the container will use the host's network configuration (network sharing), allowing the container to directly access the host's network interface, which is suitable for scenarios that require low latency and direct access to network resources. --shm-size indicates the shared memory (/dev/shm) size of the specified container, which can be set by the user. 1g is an example value. For multi-modal understanding models, if the maximum number of business concurrencies is high, it is recommended that --shm-size be set to no less than 100g. This value cannot exceed the total remaining physical memory of the host,can be viewed using the `free -h` command. When data parallelism is enabled (that is, when DP>1), the shared memory size needs to be adjusted as DP increases: When DP=2, shm-size is at least 2g. When DP=4, shm-size is at least 3g. When DP=8, shm-size is at least 5g. When DP=16, shm-size is at least 9g. --name means to specify a name for the container. \<container-name> is the identifier of the container, which can be set by yourself and is unique in the current system. If not set, Docker will automatically assign a random name. --device means mapping the host device to the container. Each --device parameter shares a host device (such as a hardware accelerator card or other hardware device) to the container so that the container can directly access it. /dev/davinci_manager: davinci related management equipment. /dev/hisi_hdc: hdc related management equipment. /dev/devmm_svm: Memory management related devices. /dev/ascend_manager: Ascend device management related devices. /dev/user_config: User configuration related equipment, which needs to be mounted when executing commands such as npu-smi in the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module container. /dev/davinci*X*: NPU device, *X* is the ID number, such as: davinci0. You can query the device number and name according to the `ll /dev/ \| grep davinci` command, bind the device as needed,modify "--device=****" in the above command. -v indicates that the files or directories of the physical machine are mapped to the corresponding paths within the container,the ro parameter is used to set these directories to read-only permissions. /usr/local/Ascend/driver: This path contains hardware driver files. The driver is installed on the host and mapped to the container before it can be used in the container. Please modify it according to the actual path where the driver is located. /usr/local/sbin: This path contains NPU status viewing commands such as npu-smi. saved so that the container can access the weights. Please modify it according to the actual path. (The weight file and the data set file are placed in this path at the same time) For the Atlas 200I Pro acceleration module, additional files or directories that npu-smi related commands depend on need to be mounted according to the container image operating system: /etc/sys_version.conf: system version configuration file. /etc/ld.so.conf.d/mind_so.conf: dynamic library search path configuration file. /etc/hdcBasic.cfg: hdc basic configuration file. /var/dmp_daemon: Directory related to dmp_daemon running. /usr/local/sbin/npu-smi: npu-smi command. /usr/local/Ascend/driver/lib64: driver dynamic library directory. /etc/slog.conf, /var/slogd: log configuration file and log running directory. /usr/lib64/libmmpa.so, /usr/lib64/libcrypto.so.1.1, /usr/lib64/libstackcore.so: general dynamic libraries that npu-smi depends on. /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libyaml-0.so.2: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the Ubuntu 24.04 image. /usr/lib64/libyaml-0.so.2.0.9: The libyaml dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image. /usr/lib64/libsemanage.so.2: The libsemanage dynamic library that npu-smi depends on under the openEuler 24.03 image.
2. Execute the following command to enter the container. `docker exec -it <container-name> bash `
3. Install dependencies. Before using the model for inference, you need to install the corresponding dependencies. The path of the dependency installation file (requirements_*xxx*.txt) of each model is /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models. Taking the LLaMA3 series model as an example, use the following command to install the dependencies. `cd /usr/local/Ascend/atb-models/requirements/models pip3 install -r requirements_llama3.txt `
4. Execute the following command to enable MindIE log printing. `export MINDIE_LOG_TO_STDOUT="true" `
5. Use models for inference. Take the LLaMA3 series model as an example. For details, please refer to the instructions in "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH/examples/models/llama3/README.md" in the container. For other models, please refer to [模型列表](https://www.hiascend.com/software/mindie/modellist). Execute the following command for inference: `cd $ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights # 请修改权重路径 ` Print the default question "Question" and the inference result "Answer", as shown below: `2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Question[0]: What's deep learning? 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Answer[0]: Deep learning is a subset of machine learning that uses neural networks to learn from data. Neural networks are 2024-11-18 11:08:13,291 [INFO] [pid: 389497] logging.py-180: Generate[0] token num: (0, 20) ` If the user wants to customize the input question, he can use the "--input_texts" parameter setting, such as: `python examples/run_pa.py --model_path /path-to-weights --input_texts "What is deep learning?" # 请修改权重路径 ` Note "$ATB_SPEED_HOME_PATH" has been set in ".bashrc", there is no need to set it yourself.

- Necessary input instructions
  - `--model_path`: local weight path, must be entered
  - `--input_image`: The local file path of the picture or video
  - `--dataset_path`: local folder path of pictures or videos
  - `--max_batch_size` : Batch Size
  - `--max_input_length`: Maximum input length (need to consider the resolution of the input image and the length of the video)
  - `--max_output_length`: Maximum output length
  - `--input_text`: input prompt
  - `--shm_name_save_path`: The saving path of the shared memory can be set to an accessible txt file.
